name: Trattoria da Amerigo
dinnerNote: Scoperta e Natura seasonal tasting menu, 5 courses (classic menu €55)
dinnerNoteIt: Menu degustazione stagionale Scoperta e Natura, 5 portate (menu classico 55 €)

menus.name: Scoperta e Natura seasonal tasting menu
menus.note: Four savoury courses and a dessert from the menu; €65 without dessert; everything but wine included; lunch or dinner; three glasses of Colli Bolognesi wines €20. In truffle season, €90 with white truffle passatelli in place of the lasagne

menus.name: Classic menu
menus.note: A starter, pasta, main and dessert chosen from the classic dishes (the Premiate Trattorie Italiane menu); everything but wine included; lunch or dinner; three glasses of Colli Bolognesi wines €20

bookingOpens: Online through the booking link on the restaurant's website (Plateform), or by phone or email.

stay.name: Locanda da Amerigo
stay.note: Five design rooms in the old inn above and beside the trattoria in Savigno.
